content: Table stakes for token-savings products include deterministic rule/memory file compression, byte-exact validation gates to prevent semantic loss, multi-IDE adapter support, offline-first privacy, and honest stats reporting. Differentiators include switchable heuristic aggression modes, description-only MCP shrink proxies, per-turn style injection to prevent model drift, and canonical profile compilation. Anti-features include LLM-based rewrites, proprietary agent runtimes, telemetry/backend in core, and mutating tool call payloads.
